name: Putting Jesus First
overview: Scripture calls believers to prioritize Jesus and His kingdom above all else, as seen in Matthew 6:33 where seeking God's kingdom and righteousness is promised to bring all other needs. The divine nature and authority of Jesus are affirmed in John 1:1 and 1:3, emphasizing that all things were created through Him. Trusting in God provides protection and purity, as Proverbs 30:5 highlights. Jesus also calls for wholehearted commitment, as indicated in Luke 14:25, and assures His followers of a prepared place with Him, promising His return in John 14:3.
